items.name: CubingUSA Mid-Atlantic Championship 2025
items.information:
This is the Mid-Atlantic championship, but anyone can compete regardless of whether they live in the Mid-Atlantic Region or not. See more information on the [Championship Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MidAtlanticChampionship2025#54674-championship-eligibility) tab.

items.information:

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) and [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/) as the Heartland Regional Championship of 2025.

Competitors from Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota and South Dakota are eligible for the title of Heartland Champion.

items.name: CubingUSA New England Championship 2025
items.information:
We are pleased to announce the 2025 CubingUSA New England Championship!

This competition is open to all competitors, but only competitors who are residents of Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Vermont, New Hampshire, and Maine are eligible to win the title of New England Champion.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjI1MTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--91e6ff49dd858ef5ca2d73c0cfcd6269eb7deb89/NEC2025-Logo.png)

items.information:
![GLC 2025 Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTA4ODgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--06655aacf63e94a0dc9e3368eb27d87f34b64986/Asset%2027@4x.png)

This competition is supported by the *[Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)* and *[CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/)* as the Great Lakes Regional Championship of 2025.

Competitors from Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Ohio, and Wisconsin are eligible for the title of Great Lakes Champion.
